newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar off, ongoing liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar off, ongoing liquidation.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were lower at midsession on Wednesday amid continued liquidation of the spot-May contract, dealers said.

Speculative selling was cited from the open in the spot-May contract, in second-position July and in the May/July spread. The front month fell to nearby support at 11.10 cents early but climbed off the low as the trade remained an excellent buyer in the May contract and in the May/July spread.
The next downside target was pegged at key psychological 11.00 cents and then between 10.80-10.90 cents basis May.
At 1130 EDT, the May/July spread stood at 0.09 compared with 0.12 on the close Tuesday.
May was down 0.07 cent to 11.06 cents per lb, having traded from 11.10 to 11.03. Most-active July fell 0.04 cent to 11.97, while the remaining months were unchanged to 0.02 lower.
Volume was estimated at 15,609 lots as of 1100 EDT.
"The market is taking a breather, and unless the specs become aggressive sellers we could steady and consolidate 10-15 points (basis May) to the upside," a dealer said.
Added pressure could come late in the week, however, as the speculators, who are still long the May contract, move out of their positions, trading sources said.
The last trading day for the May contract is April 30.
Open interest in May fell 1,467 lots to 55,622 lots as of Monday's close, while open interest in July climbed 4,608 lots to 64,546 lots.
((-- S Rostler, New York Commodity Desk, 212 859 1640))
